title: SABER: Benchmarking Operational Safety of LLM Coding Agents in Stateful Project Workspaces
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical operational safety, such as preventing data destruction, unauthorized access, and information leakage in coding environments. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks. The inclusion of the 'Bias & Offensiveness' metric from the SafeToolBench baseline is for comparative reference rather than a study of social bias or ethics itself.
